theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_fnd_tfe_ambient_extension
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n d : ℕ) (c : Covector (Euclid P) n ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (m : Set (Euclid P) → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, covectorEuclideanNorm α = ‖c α‖) → (∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (r : ℝ), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ≤ r) → |T ω| ≤ r * m W) → ∃ Φ : (Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) → ℝ, (∀ G₁ G₂ : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n, Continuous G₁ → HasCompactSupport G₁ → tsupport G₁ ⊆ U → Continuous G₂ → HasCompactSupport G₂ → tsupport G₂ ⊆ U → Φ (G₁ + G₂) = Φ G₁ + Φ G₂) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (G : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n), Continuous G → HasCompactSupport G → tsupport G ⊆ U → Φ (t • G) = t * Φ G) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Φ (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = T ω) ∧ ∀ (W : Set (Euclid P)) (G : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (r : ℝ), IsOpen W → CompactlyContained W U → Continuous G → HasCompactSupport G → tsupport G ⊆ W → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (G x) ≤ r) → |Φ G| ≤ r * m W
